senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (पर्थयति)
To throw or cast, to send or direct.

f. (-था)
KUNTĪ, the wife of PĀṆḌU.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, aff. अङ् and टाप्, and the semivowel changed.

ind.
1 Without, except.
2 Separately, severally.
E.
पृथ to throw or dismiss, aff. ठक्.

n. (-णं)
Separating, distinguishing.
E.
पृथक्, and करण making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Separated, sundered, made distinct.
E.
पृथक्, and कृत made.

m. plu. (-चाः)
Children of one father by wives of different classes.
E.
पृथक् separately, and क्षेच a wife.

n. (-त्वं)
Individuality, separateness, severalty.
E.
त्व added to पृथक्; also with तल्, पृथक्ता.

f. (-चा)
A plant, commonly Mūrvā, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
पृथक् separately, त्वच् skin; having a fibrous bark from which bow-strings are made.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
E.
पृथक् separate, पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीप्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A relation connected by oblation of water only.
E.
पृथक्, and पिण्ड obsequial cake.

f. (-ता)
Discrimination, judgment.
E.
पृथक् severally, आत्मन् real nature, तल् aff.; distinguishing the different nature of different things.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Several, separate, individual.
m. (-त्मा)
Individualised spirit, or that of an individual, as detached from universal spirit, or the soul of all.
E.
पृथक्, and आत्मन् self or soul.

f. (-का)
Individuality, separate or individual state of being.
E.
पृथक् separately, आत्मन् self, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Having distinct properties.
E.
पृथक्, and गुण quality.

m. (-नः)
1 An ignorant man, a fool.
2 A man of a low cast.
3 A sinner, a wicked or vicious man.
m. plu. (-नाः)
Children of one father by different mothers.
E.
पृथक् separate, away from, (virtue, &c.) and जन a man.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Various, diversified, multiform.
E.
पृथक् several, विध sort.

f. (-वी)
The earth: see पृथिवी.

m. (-जः)
1 The son of KUNTĪ, ARJUNA, &c.
2 Name of a tree.
E.
पृथा, and ज born.

m. (-तिः)
PĀṆḌU, the nominal father of the Pāṇḍava princes.
E.
पृथा KUNTĪ, and पति husband.

f. (-का)
A centipede.
E.
पृथ to throw, aff. क्वुन् fem. form.

f. (-विः)
The earth: see the next.

f. (-वी)
The earth.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, Uṇādi aff. षिवन्, fem. aff. ङीप्, and the vowel substituted for the semivowel; also with the antepenultimate^1 vowel changed to अ, पृथवी; or dropped altogether, पृथ्वी; or without the fem. aff. पृथिवि.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-क्षित्)
A king.
E.
पृथिवी, and क्षित् who rules.

n. (-लं)
The surface of the ground.
E.
पृथिवी, and तल surface.

m. (-तिः)
1 A king, a sovereign.
2 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha.
3 YAMA, regent of the dead.
E.
पृथिवी the earth, and पति master.

m. (-लः)
A king, a sovereign, a ruler.
E.
पृथिवी the earth, and पाल who nourishes.

m. (-क्रः)
A king.
E.
पृथिवी the earth, and शक्र INDRA.

mfn. (-थुः-थु or थ्वी-थुः)
1 Large, great.
2 Smart, clever.
m. (-थुः)
1 The fifth monarch of the solar dynasty in the second age.
2 A name of Agni or fire.
f. (-थुः)
1 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
2 A medicinal substance, commonly Hiṅgupatrī.
3 Opium.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, aff. कु, and र changed to ऋ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
The young of any animal.
mn. (-कः-कं)
Rice or grain flattened.
f. (-का)
Hingupatri: see पृथु.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, aff. कुकन् or पृथु as above, and कन् added.

m. (-मा)
A fish in general.
E.
पृथु large, and रोमन् hair of the human body, to which the scales of the fish may be considered analogous.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Great, large.
f. (-ला)
A medicinal substance, Hiṅgupatrī.
E.
पृथु, and लच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
पृथु large, and शेखर a crest.

m. (-न्धः)
A boar.
E.
पृथु large; स्कन्ध shoulder.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Large-bellied, stout, corpulent.
m. (-रः)
A ram.
E.
पृथु, and उदर the belly.

f. (-थ्वी)
1 The earth.
2 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
3 A medical substance and condiment, perhaps the leaf of the asafœtida plant, Hiṅgupatrī.
4 The mother of the seventh Jina, or Jains deified teacher, SUPĀRŚVA.
5 Cardamoms.
E.
the feminine form of पृथु, or पृथु the king so named, and ङीप् aff.; the domain of king PṚTHU.

f. (-का)
1 Large cardamoms.
2 Small cardamoms.
3 A small pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
पृथ्वी as above, कन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.
